I’ve urged the Trump-Vance Administration to withdraw a proposal that would put citizenship further out of reach for thousands of lawful permanent residents.

Here in Maryland, we’ve created Citizenship Maryland, an initiative bringing together partners from the public, non-profit, and private sectors to help eligible Marylanders navigate the path to naturalization.

Their proposal would roll back our efforts while undermining the civic and economic contributions immigrants make to our country.

The fight didn't end there and it isn't over now. In Maryland, we don't make it harder to vote. We make it more accessible for everyone.

As voting rights come under attack nationally, Maryland stands firm to ensure all voices are heard.
